correctness.rationale: For dimension n, the gamma-word map has coefficient 1 at z on c^n and 2+1_{d rightmost} on a one-d word, with no linear contribution from >=2 d. One-b flag h entry f_{k-1}-1 matches c^n plus adjacent one-d coefficients; summing yields gamma1^R=sum f_j+f_{n-1}-2n-1, and polar dual gives left with f0. For a simplex gamma1=2^{n+1}-n-2. Billera–Ehrenborg Theorem 5.3 (full primary PDF text and page screenshot inspected) gives coefficientwise cd-index dominance; positive one-d gamma weights give sharp gamma1 dominance, equality forces n+1 vertices (dually n+1 facets). Independently rederived gamma-word table for all degree<=4 words, first coefficients through n=34 and negative z^3 term in Gamma(c^3 d) at degree 5. All degree<=4 nonleading cd words have nonnegative positive gamma coefficients, so full gamma simplex bound holds n<=4; n4 values (1,26,43). Finite table checks supplement symbolic theorem, not prove all-dimensional statement.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks certify only stated bounded cases; universal conclusion rests on symbolic proof.
